translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: Filemón
book.title: Kart daa bzej Páblona' na' bseḻeen lao Filemónna'

content: Nad' Pablo, dia' lillyani daa chyix̱ji'a xtill' Cristo Jesúza', chzej' li' Filemón. Na' len beṉ' bish'cho Timotewi chwapnto' li' chiox, daa ḻe chakinto' li', na' daa nakcho txen choncho xshin Chioza'.

Na' ḻekzka' chwapnto' chiox beṉ' zancho Ápiana', na' beṉ' bish'cho Arquípona', beena' nakcho txen chdiḻ-lencho dii mala' daa choncho xshin Chioza', na' beṉ'ka' chdop chllag lillo'na' choe'la'ole Crístona'.
X̱acho Chioza' na' X̱ancho Jesucrístona' gaklenshgagake' le' na' wzoagake' le' mbalaz.
Toshiizi kat' choe'ḻwill' Chioza' chjadinid' li' na' cho'ane' yeḻ' chox̱ken ni c̱ho',
ḻa' ba ṉezid' ka nonḻilalloo X̱ancho Jesucrístona' na' chakilo' yog' beṉ'ka' nak lall' na' Chioza'.
Chṉabid' Chioza' gaklene' li' gono' ka dii le we'leno' beṉ' cho'a xtilleena' daa ba wyajḻi'o kwenc̱he shajni'chilo' kwasḻoḻ ka nak dii wenka' naki c̱hecho daa nakcho Crístona' txen.
Beṉ' bish', chiba chizakid' daa chakilo' bish' ljwello'ka', na' dii xen chtipan lallaa, ḻa' ṉezid' chtipo' lall' beṉ'ka' nak lall' na' Chioza'.
Na' daan, ḻa'kzi nap' yeḻ' wṉabia'na' beṉ Crístona', na' wak gon' byen iṉia' li' daa chiyaḻ' gono', sheḻ'ka',
chakid' wenlan gat'yoid' li' gono' daa cheenid' daa chaki ljwellcho. Nad' Pablo ba nak' beṉ' gol na' dia' lillyani daa chyix̱ji'a xtill' Cristo Jesúza',
chṉabid' li' to goklen c̱he Onésimoni, beeni nak ka xiiṉ' daa be'lenee xtill' Crístona' shlak dia' lillyani.
Kana' wzoalene' li' bi bene' ka dii le gone' xshino'na', san ṉaa wak gaklene' li' ka chaklene' nad'.
Na' chiseḻaane' lawo'na', ḻa'kzi ḻe chakyeshii lall'dawaani yizee daa chakchgaidee. Na' li' ṉaa, bilebshe', kon gakilo' nad'kzan' chilebo'.
Goklallaa wkwaaṉa'ne' gaklene' nad' lo xḻatjo' shlak dia' lillyani ni c̱he dill' wen dill' kob c̱he Crístona'.
Per bi goklallaa wkwaaṉa'ne' shi bi wc̱hebgaxjo', kwenc̱he yeḻ' goklen daa gono' c̱ha' bi gonyaadiazo'n, san gono'n do yic̱hj do lalloo.
Shi bizee lillo'na' shloll kwenc̱he ṉaa gake' lall' no' toshiizi.

Na' bich gake' to beṉ' ndoo lla yel chone' xshin beṉ' san gake' beṉ' bishoo, beṉ' gakilo'. Nad' ḻe chakidee, na' li' chiyaḻ' gakchilo'ne' aga ka bish' ljwellzo', san ka dowalj beṉ' bishoo daa nakle toz nonḻilall'le X̱ancho Jesucrístona'.
Na' shi nako' nad' txen lo xshin Crístona', bilebshe', kon gakilo' nad'kzan chlebo'.
Na' shi bi bene' c̱ho' wa shi bi chbaguee c̱ho', na' wc̱hixjo'n nad'.
Kwin nad', Pablo chzej' dga, na' nia' li': Nad' c̱hixjaan. Na' bi nia' li' ḻekzka' chbagoo c̱ha' daa ba napo' yeḻ' mban zejḻi kaṉi.
Beṉ' bish', chṉabid' li' yeḻ' goklenni daa chakicho X̱ancho Jesucrístona'. Ben ka soa' mbalaz daa nakcho toz nx̱enilall'cho Crístona'.
Chzej' li' daa ṉezid' nako' beṉ' wizoa dill', na' ṉezid' ax̱t dii xenchlə gono' aga ka daa chṉabid' li'.
Na' ḻekzka' nia' li', benshao'sha gana' soa', ḻa' daa choe'ḻwill-le Chioza' ni c̱ha', non' lez yichej' ni na' wi'e latj yidwia' le'.
Chwap Epáfrazi li' chiox, beeni nak' txen dento' lillyani ni c̱he xtill' Cristo Jesúza'.
Na' ḻekzka' Márconi, Aristárconi, Démazi, na'ch Lúcazi, beṉ'ki chaklen nad' lo xshin Chioza', chwapgake' li' chiox.
X̱ancho Jesucrístona' soalenshgue' le' na' gaklene' le'.
